description.en: Plugins for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏用的插件。

description.en: Lists installed plugins and where each one lives, pins favourites, opens a plugin folder in Finder, and adds a plugin market: catalog growth trends, a 7-day growth ranking, whole-catalog search with Chinese terms, and one-click install.
description.zh: 列出已安装插件并标出入口位置，支持置顶与在访达定位目录；市场页提供目录增长趋势、7 天增长榜、支持中文的全库搜索和一键安装。

description.en: Adds a native "Phone access (iOS)" settings page with four switchable connection methods: LAN, Cloudflare (zero install on the phone), Tailscale (fixed address), and EasyTier (self-hosted mesh via SOCKS5). Scan a QR to sign in — no password needed, and rebuilds no longer require re-scanning.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增原生「手机访问（iOS）」：局域网 / Cloudflare / Tailscale / EasyTier 四种连接方式可随时切换。扫码即连、无需密码；重新安装后也不用重新扫码。Cloudflare 与局域网手机端零安装。
